description: Use when a Husky hook drags files the change never touched into a commit or rejects it for unrelated code — a `.husky/pre-commit` running the repository formatter followed by `git add -A`, `git status` showing modified spec, source, or config files outside the intended scope after a failed commit, a diff far larger than the change, or a lint / unit-test failure at commit or push time in code the branch does not own.
